summary: Frontend-only homepage layout test for https://i18n-recovery-1.preview.emergentagent.com. All visual sections render correctly. One critical issue: Header CTA links to /begin-journey instead of /consulenza.

ui_bugs.issue: Header 'PRENOTA UNA CONSULENZA' button links to /begin-journey instead of /consulenza. Both desktop (mfd-header__inner) and mobile (mfd-mobile-menu) links use /begin-journey.

action_items: Fix Header CTA href from /begin-journey to /consulenza (both desktop and mobile menu variants)
critical_code_review_comments: In HomePage.jsx or Header component, the CTA button in mfd-header__inner and mfd-mobile-menu still uses href='/begin-journey' - must be changed to href='/consulenza'
context_for_next_testing_agent: All homepage sections pass visually: Hero (Il tuo spazio, 2 CTAs, hero image), HowItWorks (4 steps 01-04 serif), EditorialStatement (2-col text+image), DesignStories (6 projects 3-col, SCOPRI IL PROGETTO), DigitalJourneyHighlight (BRIEF DIGITALE, 4 icon cards), Magazine (horizontal thumbnails + LEGGI L'ARTICOLO x3), FinalCTA (3-col dark), Footer (multi-col dark). Only bug: header/mobile CTA href is /begin-journey instead of /consulenza.
rca_of_issue: The Header component in HomePage.jsx or the shared Header/Nav component renders the main CTA with href='/begin-journey'. The requirement says all public CTA buttons should navigate to /consulenza. Need to search for 'begin-journey' in the header/nav source and replace with '/consulenza'.
